tier_definitions.I: OWNED long-term: Rust-first crates we author, or OSS under a permissive license with sufficient bus-factor for downstream maintenance.
tier_definitions.II: VENDOR-SEAMED temporary: external vendor we depend on today; MUST have a port-in-kernel seam + >=2 adapter impls; phase-out plan canonical.
tier_definitions.III: FORBIDDEN: hyperscaler-specific service lock-in OR commercial-only tool with OSS equivalent; refuse to adopt.

entries.name: rust-toolchain
entries.adoption_rationale: Canonical implementation language for Oyatie; ADR-0096 supervisor-language-rust-not-node confirms Rust-first.

entries.name: postgres
entries.adoption_rationale: Canonical OLTP database; ADR-0045 database tier strategy.

entries.name: citus
entries.adoption_rationale: Postgres-native horizontal sharding for tenants in a cell; ADR-0045.

entries.name: valkey
entries.adoption_rationale: Long-term Redis-compatible target after Redis Inc. moved to RSALv2 in 2024; canonical KV cache.

entries.name: redis
entries.adoption_rationale: Currently in dependency graph for compatibility; Tier-I-with-asterisk because RSALv2 is not OSI-OSS; long-term we migrate to valkey.
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: Valkey 8.x ships stable + cluster-mode parity demonstrated

entries.name: meilisearch
entries.adoption_rationale: Hybrid lexical+vector search service; ADR-0047 search backend strategy.

entries.name: tantivy
entries.adoption_rationale: Rust-native embedded full-text index used inside µservices for in-process search.

entries.name: openbao
entries.adoption_rationale: Community fork of HashiCorp Vault post-BUSL relicense; ADR-0043 secrets management.

entries.name: kubernetes
entries.adoption_rationale: Canonical workload orchestrator; ADR-0028 + ADR-0121.

entries.name: argocd
entries.adoption_rationale: GitOps controller; ADR-0041 GitOps trunk-based.

entries.name: cilium
entries.adoption_rationale: eBPF-based service mesh + NetworkPolicy substrate; ADR-0148.

entries.name: cedar
entries.adoption_rationale: Policy language for authorization; ADR-0007 Cedar policy + persona tier. Bus-factor mitigated by spec stability and active community.

entries.name: loro-crdt
entries.adoption_rationale: Best Rust-native CRDT today for collaborative editing in notes/sheets/slides.
entries.replacement_path: yrs (Yrs/Yjs Rust port) OR automerge-rs via the portability trait
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: yrs reaches feature-parity OR loro maintainer signal is lost for >180d
entries.phase_out_target_date_or_signal: signal: yrs parity OR loro maintenance lapse

entries.name: pandoc
entries.adoption_rationale: Doc conversion sidecar; PROCESS-BOUNDARY ONLY (never linked into Rust binaries — invoked as separate OS process so GPL does not propagate).

entries.name: libreoffice-headless
entries.adoption_rationale: Doc rendering sidecar for sheets/slides export; PROCESS-BOUNDARY ONLY.

entries.name: ffmpeg
entries.adoption_rationale: Video/audio transcoding; PROCESS-BOUNDARY (sidecar); used by recordings + meet.

entries.name: imagemagick-libvips
entries.adoption_rationale: Image processing; libvips preferred for memory efficiency. PROCESS-BOUNDARY.

entries.name: gvisor
entries.adoption_rationale: User-space kernel sandboxing for foundry agent containers; ADR-0147.

entries.name: kata-containers
entries.adoption_rationale: VM-isolated container runtime; ADR-0147 ladder rung.

entries.name: cloud-hypervisor
entries.adoption_rationale: Primary VMM per ADR-0147 amendment (Rust-native; lightweight).

entries.name: grafana-mimir
entries.adoption_rationale: Long-term Prometheus-compatible metrics store; ADR-0042. PROCESS-BOUNDARY (HTTP service — AGPL does not propagate to clients).

entries.name: grafana-loki
entries.adoption_rationale: Log aggregation; ADR-0042. PROCESS-BOUNDARY.

entries.name: grafana-tempo
entries.adoption_rationale: Distributed tracing store; ADR-0042. PROCESS-BOUNDARY.

entries.name: grafana-pyroscope
entries.adoption_rationale: Continuous profiling; ADR-0042. PROCESS-BOUNDARY.

entries.name: grafana-alloy
entries.adoption_rationale: OTel collector replacement; ADR-0042.

entries.name: prometheus
entries.adoption_rationale: Metrics collection substrate; ADR-0042.

entries.name: opentelemetry
entries.adoption_rationale: Vendor-neutral telemetry standard; ADR-0042.

entries.name: minio
entries.adoption_rationale: S3-protocol-compatible OSS object store; one of multiple impls for the S3 protocol surface.

entries.name: garage
entries.adoption_rationale: S3-protocol-compatible OSS object store; lightweight alternative to MinIO for small cells.

entries.name: seaweedfs
entries.adoption_rationale: S3-protocol-compatible OSS object store; high-density blob substrate alternative.

entries.name: s3-protocol
entries.adoption_rationale: Object-storage protocol; treated as Tier I because the protocol is open and we always ship at least one OSS impl (MinIO/Garage/SeaweedFS) alongside any managed-vendor impl. The protocol is NOT the lock-in; the managed service would be.

entries.name: anthropic-api
entries.adoption_rationale: Frontier-class LLM access for foundry providers; in-house substrate (ADR-0026) not at parity yet. ADR-0020 multi-provider adapter model.
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: human-eval >= 95% on internal benchmark set + tool-use parity + per-second-token throughput parity at target cost

entries.name: anthropic-subscription
entries.adoption_rationale: OAuth/subscription auth path (Claude Code); ADR-0020.

entries.name: openai-api
entries.adoption_rationale: Frontier-class LLM access; ADR-0020.

entries.name: openai-subscription
entries.adoption_rationale: Codex subscription auth path; ADR-0020.

entries.name: google-gemini-api
entries.adoption_rationale: Frontier-class LLM access; ADR-0020.

entries.name: google-gemini-subscription
entries.adoption_rationale: Subscription auth path; ADR-0020.

entries.name: github-actions
entries.adoption_rationale: CI runtime; ADR-0050 automation-first pipeline; ADR-0123 onprem-tooling-paired.
entries.replacement_path: GitHub (interim) Actions OR Woodpecker CI on private Kubernetes
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: private-cloud Kubernetes cluster runs GitHub + runners + cosign chain dogfooded on a non-critical lane for >=90d with parity to GitHub Actions cache + matrix + reusable workflows
entries.seam_adapter_trait: .github/workflows/*.yml (portable to GitHub Actions syntax; workflows author against vanilla actions where possible)
entries.phase_out_target_date_or_signal: signal: Foundry VCS substrate (ADR-0113) + GitHub runners reach parity

entries.name: github-vcs-and-pr-platform
entries.adoption_rationale: Code hosting + PR + issues + reviews substrate today. ADR-0116 retired external agent-coordination tooling; ADR-0113 Foundry VCS substrate is the long-term replacement.
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: Foundry VCS substrate reaches release-pointer parity (merge queue + admission gates + reviewer-agent integration) on a private GitHub cell
entries.seam_adapter_trait: agent-coordination surface = Foundry pipeline (already abstracted per CLAUDE.md), not raw GitHub APIs
entries.phase_out_target_date_or_signal: signal: Foundry VCS substrate stable on GitHub

entries.name: cloudflare-cdn
entries.adoption_rationale: NOT CURRENTLY ADOPTED. Pre-classified Tier II so adoption requires this ADR's discipline. Replacement substrate available today: Envoy + Varnish on private edge nodes.
entries.replacement_path: self-hosted Envoy + Varnish + ACME on private edge nodes
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: edge POPs commissioned in >=3 geos with anycast routing
entries.seam_adapter_trait: crates/oya-edge-cdn-kernel (not yet created — would be created on adoption)

entries.name: fastly-cdn
entries.adoption_rationale: NOT CURRENTLY ADOPTED. Pre-classified Tier II.
entries.replacement_path: self-hosted Envoy + Varnish on private edge nodes

entries.name: aws-lambda
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Knative on Kubernetes is the canonical FaaS path.

entries.name: aws-dynamodb
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Postgres + Citus is the canonical horizontal-scale OLTP path.

entries.name: aws-cognito
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Keycloak + Cedar is the canonical identity + authz path.

entries.name: aws-secrets-manager
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. OpenBao is the canonical secrets path (ADR-0043).

entries.name: azure-cosmos-db
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Same reason as AWS DynamoDB.

entries.name: gcp-vertex-ai
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. foundry providers ARE the model-serving substrate; we accept the model-vendor (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini) Tier II surface but not the GCP-specific runtime that locks us to one cloud.

entries.name: launchdarkly
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. OpenFeature + Flipt covers the feature-flag substrate at OSS quality (ADR-0159).

entries.name: snyk
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Trivy + Grype + cargo-audit covers SCA + container scanning at OSS quality (ADR-0039).

entries.name: datadog
entries.adoption_rationale: REFUSED. Grafana stack (Mimir/Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope/Alloy) covers the observability substrate at parity (ADR-0042).

entries.name: pagerduty
entries.adoption_rationale: PRE-CLASSIFIED. Acceptable as temporary Tier II under phase-out contract; long-term target is Grafana OnCall.
entries.replacement_readiness_gate: Grafana OnCall reaches Slack/Teams escalation parity + on-call rotation parity
